{{Top|leg}}
'''Krex Alto''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] hired by [[Zelto Sliteye]]. Alto was contracted to kill [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Precipitator]] [[Minas-Coth Cray]] at [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].

==Biography==
Krex Alto was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] for hire, selling their services to the highest bidder. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Alto was contracted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zelto Sliteye]] at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. Sliteye wanted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Precipitator]] [[Minas-Coth Cray]] dead to send a message to the Empire that Ord Mynock Freeport was his to rule.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Alto was a careful planner, and did not like to let his employer down. The mercenary planned to make the assassination of Cray untraceable so that no blame would fall on Sliteye.<ref name="Game" />

==Equipment==
Alto wore [[bounty hunter armor]], and was armed with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]], and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. The mercenary also carried a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], two [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], and a [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash-bang grenade]].<ref name="Game" />
